attchmntText: Pre-facto intimation of the upcoming 67th (Sixty- Seventh) meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC).
Intimation regarding bankruptcy of Mr. Venugopal Dhoot.
voiceSummary: Value Industries Limited, a company under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, has received an order from the National Company Law Tribunal declaring promoter Venugopal Dhoot as insolvent. The order was delivered on November 05, 2026, in response to a petition filed by State Bank of India. The declaration follows the failure of Dhoot's personal insolvency resolution process and repayment plan. The total amount in default, including interest and penalties, is stated as Rs. 1,26,68,06,12,956.76. The company is managed by Resolution Professional Abhijit Guhathakurta.

attchmntText: Intimation regarding postponement of the 67th (Sixty Seventh) meeting of the Committee of Creditors (CoC).
voiceSummary: Value Industries Limited has postponed its 67th Committee of Creditors meeting, originally scheduled for November 20, 2026. The meeting concerned the consolidated corporate insolvency resolution process for Value Industries Limited and 12 other Videocon group companies. The postponement was made at the request of the Committee of Creditors. The revised date and time for the meeting will be communicated later. The company is currently under a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ordered by the NCLT on September 5, 2018. Abhijit Guhathakurta is serving as the Resolution Professional for the 13 Videocon Group companies.

attchmntText: Pre-facto intimation of the upcoming 67th meeting of the Committee of Creditors to be held on November 20, 2026.
voiceSummary: Value Industries Limited has issued a pre-facto intimation regarding the 67th meeting of the consolidated Committee of Creditors. The meeting involves Value Industries Limited and 12 other Videocon group companies under a consolidated corporate insolvency resolution process. The meeting is scheduled for Friday, November 20, 2026. This notice is provided in accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015, and Regulation 19 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India Regulations, 2016. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by NCLT order dated 05th September, 2018, read with orders dated 8th August, 2019, and 25th September, 2019. Abhijit Guhathakurta is the Resolution Professional for the 13 Videocon Group companies.

attchmntText: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015 Order of the Supreme Court of India in response to appeal under Section 62 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
voiceSummary: Value Industries Limited intimates that the Supreme Court of India dismissed appeals under Section 62 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, vide order dated November 16, 2026. The Court rejected Civil Appeal Nos. 894, 512, and 509 of 2022 filed by the Successful Resolution Applicant. The Court also dismissed Civil Appeal No. 1307 of 2022, Civil Appeal Nos. 8659 to 8661 of 2026, Civil Appeal Nos. 8718 and 8719 of 2026, and Civil Appeal Diary Nos. 41234 and 41286 of 2026 concerning foreign oil and gas assets. No order was passed regarding costs. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process by NCLT order dated 05th September, 2018.
